object: The Block album by New Kids on the Block
belief: The album "The Block" by New Kids on the Block has a single "Summertime" which was released on May 13, 2008

author: worker_2
belief: The album "The Block" by New Kids on the Block does NOT have a single called "The Hardest Way to Make a Hard Living". The singles from this album are: "Summertime" (May 13, 2008), "Single" (August 12, 2008), "Dirty Dancing" (December 19, 2008), and "2 in the Morning" (February 23, 2009).
